Here is the full extracted content for each page's blue-sec CTA section:

---

## beta.html — TWO blue-sec sections

### 1. `section-regular-3 blue-sec makeit-sec` (lines 484–523) — "How It Works" 3-step section

This is a **content section**, not a final CTA. It lives above the standalone CTA.

- **Tag badge:** "How it works"
- **h2:** `Simple to start. Structured to scale.`
- **Subtitle:** "From signup to first delivery — here's exactly what happens."
- **3 feature cards (class `feature-card space-between blue padding-btm`):**
  1. "Choose Your Plan" — "Pick Lite or Pro. Your dedicated delivery owner and Smart Client Workspace go live within 12 hours. No ramp-up, no waiting." — Badge: "⚡ Live in 12 hours"
  2. "Submit Your First Task" — "Use your dashboard to submit any WordPress or Shopify request. We start the same day. Track live progress without chasing anyone." — Badge: "📋 Same-day start"
  3. "Review, Approve & Send" — "Receive QA-checked, white-label work in 24–48h. Approve in your workspace, then send straight to your client — under your brand." — Badge: "✅ Client-ready output"

### 2. `blue-sec beta-blue` (lines 560–593) — Standalone CTA (the actual book-section)

- **Section classes:** `blue-sec beta-blue`
- **book-section modifier:** `class="book-section remove-pattern"` — **YES, `remove-pattern` is present**
- **h2:** `Your Execution Team. Live in 12 Hours.`
- **Subtitle/p:** "Reserve your beta spot. Lock in pricing and start delivering client work through Boldteq before we open publicly."
- **4 bullet points (`white-li-icon`):**
  1. "Beta pricing locked in"
  2. "Priority onboarding — live in 12 hours"
  3. "14-day satisfaction guarantee"
  4. "Pause or cancel anytime"
- **Button:** `class="sky-button"` → `Reserve My Spot` → href `book-a-demo.html`
- **No second button** (single CTA only)
- **Image asset:** `images/Group-1.svg` (check icon)

---

## how-it-works.html — ONE blue-sec section

### `section-regular-3 blue-sec makeit-sec` (lines 409–439) — "How White Label Web Development Works"

This is a **content/process section only** — there is NO standalone `book-section` CTA with `book-section remove-pattern` on this page.

- **Tag badge:** "How it works"
- **h2:** `How White Label Web Development Works`
- **Subtitle:** "A structured execution system built for agencies — simple requests, predictable delivery, and full white-label support."
- **3 feature cards (with screenshot images, NO inner-badge):**
  1. "Choose Your Subscription" — "Start scaling today. Your delivery team is live within 12 hours." — Image: `Rectangle-243.png` (Order Summary)
  2. "Submit Your Tasks" — "Submit requests anytime. We start within hours, not days." — Image: `Rectangle-244.png` (Task Title field)
  3. "Review & Approve" — "We deliver white-label work you can confidently send to your clients." — Image: `Rectangle-186.png` (Homepage redesign)

The page's CTA is in the adjacent `how-work-sec3` section (not a `blue-sec`): button `Book a Demo` → `book-a-demo.html` (class `a-gulf-book`).

---

## scope.html — ONE blue-sec section

### `blue-sec` (lines 1942–1974) — Standalone book-section CTA

- **Section classes:** `blue-sec` (no extra modifier — cleaner than beta-blue)
- **book-section modifier:** `class="book-section remove-pattern"` — **YES, `remove-pattern` is present**
- **h2:** `Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?`
- **Subtitle/p:** "Partner with Boldteq as your dedicated backend delivery team and gain a reliable, scalable foundation for your technology initiatives."
- **3 bullet points (`white-li-icon`):**
  1. "Agencies with fluctuating demand"
  2. "Large monthly task volumes"
  3. "Multiple brands or clients"
- **Tick icon:** `images/blue-tick.svg` (different from beta.html which uses `images/Group-1.svg`)
- **2 buttons (`_2-btns-grid full-width-mob`):**
  1. `class="a-gulf-book full-width"` → `Book a Demo` → href `book-a-demo.html`
  2. `class="white-btn"` → `View Plans` → href `pricing.html`

---

## testimonials.html — NO blue-sec section

There is **no `blue-sec` section** anywhere in `testimonials.html`. The page goes directly from the testimonials grid (`work-sec2`) to the `footer`. The page has no standalone CTA banner.
